item.name: Rune of Wind
item.summary: A consumable that makes eligible WINDY-native auras roll at native rarity without requiring WINDY to be active.
item.cardSummary: Targets the WINDY aura pool for ten minutes.
item.effect: Allows eligible WINDY-native auras to roll at their native rarity regardless of the current biome.
item.obtainment: Achievements, quests, Random Rune Chests, Memory Match, and merchant shops.

item.name: Rune of Everything
item.summary: A powerful consumable that combines supported biome-native aura access for a shorter activation window.
item.cardSummary: Targets all supported biome pools for five minutes.
item.effect: Allows eligible aura pools from supported biomes to roll at native rarity during the activation.
item.obtainment: Achievements, quests, Random Rune Chests, Memory Match, and merchant shops.
item.exceptions: The current atwiki item table excludes Singularity, Glitched, Cyberspace, and Dreamspace, along with aura-specific rune exclusions.
